items.headline: Jon Rahm's 2024 PGA Comments
items.text: Jon Rahm claimed at the 2024 PGA Championship that he still supported the PGA Tour despite moving to LIV Golf, a statement that was widely unpopular among players.

items.headline: Scheffler Nears Tiger's Money Record
items.text: Scottie Scheffler is poised to surpass Tiger Woods on the PGA Tour's all-time career money list as early as the 2026 BMW Championship, threatening one of Woods' iconic records based on PGA Tour prize money.
